findings.message: `render_context` is `context_excerpt(entry, (repo / context_path(entry)).read_text())`, so the try block also covers the file read. `UnicodeDecodeError` is a subclass of `ValueError`. A ticket Context file that is not valid UTF-8, with or without a selector, used to raise. It now becomes the notice `selector does not resolve in this worktree: 'utf-8' codec can't decode ...`. That hides an error other than the selector ValueError and labels it wrongly as a selector problem. The Definition of rejected says: "The branch swallows errors other than the selector ValueError."
findings.paved_road: Narrow the guard to selector resolution. In `implement_inputs`, read the text outside the try with `text = (repo / context_path(p)).read_text()`, then wrap only `context_excerpt(p, text)` in try/except ValueError. Both are already in `clutch/tickets.py`, which this change leaves alone. Decode errors and missing files then still raise as before. Alternatively, re-raise when `isinstance(exc, UnicodeDecodeError)`.
